summary: A handbook that gives a young thrower a steady stance and a flat sidearm whirl for open ground.

summary: A drill-book that builds the shoulder with heavy stones and teaches long throws and close defence with the cord.

title: Handbook of Steady Aim at Range
summary: A handbook for the newly awakened on ranging a far mark and adding a thread of qi to steady the throw.

title: The Qi-Fed Whirl: A Primer for the Newly Awakened
summary: A primer on charging the cord with first qi and whirling faster with a sharper crack at release.

title: A Canon of Cord Care and Clean Release
summary: A canon that pairs careful cord upkeep with clean flat releases and a quick way to snare a reaching hand.

title: Workbook of Bullet and Pouch Fundamentals

title: The Open-Ground Slinger's Handbook
